picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Saffron has conceded three points in three weeks. Viridian just lost a twenty-one-point lead. The defense should make this argument considerably shorter than the Titans would prefer.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Tare’s four-sack afternoon gives me a specific reason to distrust Viridian’s protection. Saffron should force enough difficult passing downs for Lamb and Skattebo to build the lead.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Viridian’s first half against Cinnabar showed useful offense. I still trust Saffron to sustain its work longer, especially after the Titans lost possession four times.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Trent Scarboro gets another opponent carrying a fresh offensive crisis. Lamb supplies the yards, Skattebo supplies the finish, and Viridian supplies a long trip home.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The Titans need repeated successful drives against a defense that has allowed seventy-three season points. Saffron’s rushing production should support enough scoring even if Manning remains uneven.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Vermilion’s last two totals are seven and zero. I am taking Pewter to make one more useful possession, which is a modest request I reserve the right to regret.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Chandelure’s shutout included no interceptions. Against Pewter, More of those retained possessions should reach a scoring opportunity, with the Volts’ defense keeping the required total manageable.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Pewter has a chance to win without chasing an explosive offense. Its defense should preserve a close game long enough for two scoring possessions to become decisive.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Brock just supervised three points against Celadon. I will require considerably stronger evidence before trusting Pewter on the road, even against a Vermilion attack currently hiding from the end zone.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The Volts’ current playoff position gives this home game immediate value. Enough short passing production against Pewter should win a low-scoring exchange.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Cinnabar scored twenty-nine after halftime at Viridian. Cerulean’s thirteen-point win is welcome, but The Blaze should ask considerably more questions of that defense.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Gholdengo finished four touchdown passes after the break. Cinnabar should threaten Cerulean through the air before the game becomes another emergency recovery exercise.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The comeback gives Blaine evidence that his offense can respond under pressure. I favor that passing group over a Tide attack that needed only thirteen last week.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Blaine has four second-half touchdown passes available for anyone still pretending Cinnabar cannot score. The Blaze should begin the useful part of the afternoon much earlier this time.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Cerulean can keep the opening competitive, but Gholdengo’s receiving options should produce the extra touchdown that separates these teams.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Azalea has rested while Lavender has added another injured runner. The Swarm should catch the Wails during another offensive adjustment and turn a close game their way.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Frosmoth found Wailord eight times last week. That reliable receiving work gives Lavender an answer while the rushing roles change, and It should survive Azalea’s defensive pressure.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Lavender has won three straight with different contributors carrying the difficult possessions. I trust that developing confidence at home more than a projection built entirely around the newest absence.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Hobbes is out, Mr. Clanky is out and People Eater is out. Bugsy has had a bye to prepare. Azalea should make Lavender’s remaining options feel the full weight of that list.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Machoke and Diggersby already supplied useful rushing yards against Mahogany. With Frosmoth’s receiving connections established, Lavender should produce enough balanced possessions to protect home field.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: The Reds answered their first defeat with forty-five points and a division title. Mahogany’s latest answer was fourteen. The numerical disagreement should continue.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Lynch restored the rushing game with 131 yards, and Thorpe completed eighteen of twenty-two. That combination should keep Mt. Silver out of the difficult passing situations Mahogany needs.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Mahogany converted its two takeaways into touchdowns at Lavender. I doubt Mt. Silver offers the same assistance, especially after Thorpe’s clean passing day against Olivine.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Connor McLarren has the division banner and the best record in his conference. Garshawn Lynch has three fresh rushing touchdowns. Both arguments should travel successfully.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The Frost need offense beyond turnover-created opportunities. I expect Mt. Silver’s rushing and retained possessions to deny them enough chances to keep pace.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Olivine follows a 45–0 defeat with a visit to a team that has scored thirty twice in a row. The Dragons should preserve that deeply inconvenient schedule pattern.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Blackthorn’s passing has been productive against Mt. Silver and Violet. Olivine’s short completions will struggle to match it unless the Ironclads produce much more after the catch.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Ironclads need a calmer game after three turnovers at Mt. Silver. Blackthorn’s offense should make that difficult by forcing them to pursue points rather than simply retain possession.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Hatterene has given Blackthorn consecutive thirty-point afternoons. Olivine brings zero from its last game. I am taking the offense that has actually introduced itself to the scoreboard.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The Ironclads’136 passing yards on twenty-one completions leave too little gain per successful throw. Blackthorn should create more valuable possessions and establish a two-score advantage.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Cianwood has had a bye to work while Violet has lost twice. The Crushers’ running game should make the Falcons defend a more patient afternoon than they want.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Violet can recover at home if it makes Cianwood throw beyond the comfortable rushing situations. The Falcons should create enough passing production of their own to finish narrowly ahead.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Crushers have been close to useful wins, including the one-point loss to Lavender. Their rested running group should make the difference in another game with little separation.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Violet’s four-game winning streak has been followed by two defeats. Cianwood should keep the ball on the ground and make the Falcons prove they can stop the retreat.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The home side has the narrower route to victory: contain Bibarel and avoid repeating the interceptions from Olivine. Violet should manage both well enough for a small win.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Rustboro’s defense just supplied three takeaways. Enough of that disruption should survive the trip, although Fortree should find this passing assignment less absurd than Mossdeep’s.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Timmy, Gengar and Shieldon all produced useful receiving yards against Mauville. Those available targets should give Rustboro enough answers without requiring a perfect defensive game.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Stone have tangible evidence of recovery after the Mossdeep loss. The clean passing and late defensive stops from the Mauville game should carry into another useful win.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Winona has an entire defense to embarrass into a response, and Floatzel still supplied a fifty-five-yard touchdown against Mossdeep. Fortree’s best rushing version should catch Rustboro looking ahead.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Rustboro retained its passing possessions and forced Mauville’s late mistakes. That combination should work against Fortree, provided the Stone prevent the long rushing play from becoming a recurring problem.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Petalburg has nine wins. Mossdeep has twelve and just gave one receiver 376 yards. The Pride should make this respectable without making me change the top of the rankings.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Marino took no sacks while throwing 550 yards. Petalburg has a much stronger overall record than Fortree, but Mossdeep’s protection and multiple receiving targets should keep producing scoring chances.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Pride have earned a serious visit between division leaders. I still favor Mossdeep’s established passing partnerships to provide the extra possessions that separate a competitive game from an upset.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: I would enjoy picking Norman here. Unfortunately, Marino’s passing and the Eclipse’s protection have supplied inconvenient evidence. Petalburg should compete and Mossdeep to win anyway.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The new Revis absence gives Petalburg something specific to test. Mossdeep’s passing efficiency and available rushing contribution should outweigh that opening over the full game.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Dewford stayed within four of Petalburg. The Breakers should bring enough offense to beat a Surge team that needed only fourteen in its latest win.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Sootopolis has just won a division road game and now gets home field. Its defense should keep Dewford’s scoring modest while the available offense supplies the deciding possession.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Surge have continued finding useful results despite the receiving absence. The home setting and a manageable scoring requirement should give them a narrow win.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Wallace has a 5–7 team that just won 14–10. Dewford just lost 14–10. The Surge should keep the favorable version of that exchange when the teams meet directly.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The Breakers need a road response after Petalburg, and Two finished touchdown drives should be enough if their defense keeps Sootopolis’s passing gains contained.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Mauville turned 239 passing yards into three points. Lavaridge should keep the game close until another unsuccessful Dynamos possession gives the home side the useful margin.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: The Inferno can attack a Mauville team that just lost three possessions. I expect a close passing exchange, with Lavaridge’s home offense making one fewer costly mistake.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Mothim caught nine of ten targets at Rustboro. Mauville should preserve that reliable connection and find just enough better finishing to win a close road game.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Wattson has receivers producing real yardage, and Him should get more than three points from them this week. Lavaridge’s ten-point afternoon does not persuade me to pick the home side.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The Dynamos have several productive receiving options. Improved ball security should turn that yardage into the extra scoring drive needed against Lavaridge.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Pastoria had won three straight before the Veilstone defeat. A home rebound that forces Eterna’s offense should supply more than its preferred small allowance.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Eterna held Canalave to six and has allowed 127 all season. That defense should make Pastoria’s three-point performance a problem the Waves cannot solve in one week.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Thorns have earned first place through repeated defensive work. I trust that consistency more than an immediate offensive transformation from a Pastoria team coming off three points.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Eterna keeps asking its defense to protect small totals. Crasher Wake should find enough rushing production at home to make the Thorns finally pay for a quiet offensive afternoon.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The matchup favors Eterna’s most dependable unit. The Thorns should limit Pastoria’s sustained drives and finish enough of their own opportunities to win comfortably.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Canalave scored six while Sunyshore scored fifty-three. A less extreme game than that comparison suggests, but the Starseekers have far more demonstrated ways should finish a possession.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: LaGatr’s ten catches and FLOAT SZN’s ninety-five rushing yards matter even without the five takeaways. Sunyshore should move the ball against Canalave through more than one dependable option.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Bulwark need their offense to support another difficult road assignment. Sunyshore’s receiving partnerships should produce enough points that a defensive-only answer cannot hold.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Karson Jones just received seven touchdown passes from Watzon. Byron just received six total points. The Starseekers should make Canalave bring a much more ambitious offensive explanation.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The turnover surge may not repeat, but Sunyshore’s rushing and short receiving production are still useful matchup evidence. Those ordinary gains should support another home win.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Snowpoint has consecutive wins and finally one away from home. The Blizzard should retain that slight advantage against a team still sorting through five giveaways.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Hearthome gained 335 yards against Sunyshore. Fewer lost possessions this week, allowing enough of that passing production should become points against Snowpoint.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Haunts’ final margin was much worse than their yardage production. A cleaner home game should reveal an offense capable of beating Snowpoint, even after the Blizzard’s two wins.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Fantina has five turnovers to remove from the next performance. The Haunts should keep the useful passing and deliver a much louder response at home.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Snowpoint’s consecutive victories provide the steadier recent evidence. The Blizzard should protect enough possessions to finish a close game ahead of Hearthome.
